EmailTemplate.name: Reactive-Online Employee Enrollment Access
EmailTemplate.subject: Access Insperity Online Employee Enrollment
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear client,
Congratulations again on your new hire. Your new employee can complete their online enrollment in the Insperity Premier Portal; you can share the information below with them to assist them in the process.
Thank you
[signature]
Access your Insperity Online Employee Enrollment
Once you have created your Username and Password for Insperity Premier, follow the instructions below to access your Online Employee Enrollment.
Login to Insperity Premier.
Once you are logged in you will need to select the Start Now button to access your Online Employee Enrollment.
Now you can begin your enrollment by selecting Start Now again.
If you are unable to access your Online Employee Enrollment information, please reach out to the Insperity Contact Center at 1-866-715-3552 for additional assistance.
Thank you for trusting Insperity to serve your business.
